message: The other day, we had a surprise storm roll in, and I remembered that I’d stocked up on extra batteries and flashlights a few weeks prior. When the lights flickered and went out, I felt like a superhero, zipping around the house with my trusty flashlight, while the grandkids thought it was the perfect time for a cozy indoor campout. It’s funny how a little prep can turn a stormy evening into a fun adventure. Who knew batteries could bring so much joy? ⚡
